run_goto_controller_node: run the GotoVelocityControllerNode ROS node to control a diff drive robot to a target goal pose
enable_goto_controller: call the goto_controller/enable ROS service to activate the velocity controller for goal navigation
disable_goto_controller: call the goto_controller/disable ROS service to stop the velocity controller and clear the current goal
update_velocity_profile: update the controller velocity profile by publishing to v_max, w_max, acc_lin, or acc_ang ROS topics
set_yaw_tracking: call the goto_controller/set_yaw_tracking ROS service to enable or disable yaw angle tracking for the goal
